277:t_1:36.en:
$$勝平$$
「The $$ギャラクシー船団$$... They're the guys we fought in the $$再世戦争$$!」

277:t_1:37.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Are they... plotting something bad again...?」

277:t_1:38.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「But we didn't only encounter enemies. ...Let me introduce someone.」

277:t_1:41.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Her name is $$シビル$$. She's a 《$$プロトデビルン$$》.」

277:t_1:42.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hold on! $$ミレーヌ$$ told us about the $$プロトデビルン$$ before...!」

277:t_1:43.en:
$$タケル$$
「Weren't they the enemies who fought the $$マクロス７船団$$!?」

277:t_1:44.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「That was in the past.」

277:t_1:45.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「After hearing $$バサラ$$'s song, the $$プロトデビルン$$ became able to regenerate their own $$スピリチア$$. They no longer need to attack other living beings.」

277:t_1:46.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「In other words, they've become beings just like us.」

277:t_1:47.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「We were in dire straits under $$サイデリアル$$'s attack when $$ゲペルニッチ$$, the leader of the $$プロトデビルン$$, came to help...」

277:t_1:48.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$シビル$$ joined us to support $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$.」

277:t_1:49.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「When $$バサラ$$ sings 'POWER TO THE DREAM,' $$シビル$$ joins in, too.」

277:t_1:50.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then she's one of our friends.」

277:t_1:51.en:
$$ノノ$$
「In that case, you're very welcome! We're happy to have you, $$シビル$$!」

277:t_1:54.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「It's all right, $$ワッ太$$. She's just happy.」

277:t_1:55.en:
$$アルト$$
「It took us a while to get used to it, too.」

277:t_1:56.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「...Then, during that battle, a $$時空震動$$ engulfed us and sent us to the mysterious space you also ended up in.」

277:t_1:57.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So everything after that was more or less the same.」

277:t_1:58.en:
$$甲児$$
「Still, I never expected $$サイデリアル$$ to be connected to the fundamental calamity...」

277:t_1:59.en:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah... Those forces may be their trump card.」

277:t_1:60.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The enemy's overwhelming power damages even our hearts...」

277:t_1:61.en:
$$アルト$$
「The fear I felt when I saw them was nothing like fighting our previous enemies.」

277:t_1:62.en:
$$タケル$$
「We can't wipe away that fear... They truly are a fundamental enemy of humanity.」

277:t_1:63.en:
$$アルト$$
「But we'll fight... $n has overcome fear and fought all this time, too.」

277:t_1:64.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Speaking of which, where is he...?」

277:t_1:65.en:
$$甲児$$
「...He's been unconscious since we regrouped. I think it's because his $$血塗られた眼$$ appeared in that mysterious space.」

277:t_1:67.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$アルト$$... Shouldn't $n be waking up soon?」

277:t_1:68.en:
$$アルト$$
「We can't just leave him alone. Let's go see him.」

277:t_1:74.en:
$$ハサン$$
「He's been awake for some time.」

277:t_1:75.en:
$n
「What's up with you guys? You're all here...」

277:t_1:76.en:
$$アルト$$
「What are you talking about!? We came because we were worried about you!」

277:t_1:77.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We did! We heard you suddenly collapsed...!」

277:t_1:78.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Was it the $$血塗られた眼$$ after all?」

277:t_1:81.en:
$n
「I don't know how that mysterious space, those black $$アンゲロイ$$... and the $$テンシ$$ I've been chasing are connected...」

277:t_1:82.en:
$$アマタ$$
「If your $$血塗られた眼$$ still appear, $n, does that mean $$ガドライト#pilot$$ wasn't the one who killed your family...?」

277:t_1:83.en:
$n
「I'd been preparing myself for that... I couldn't say $$ガドライト#pilot$$ and the $$テンシ$$ were unrelated, but I felt some distance between them.」

277:t_1:84.en:
$n
「And the $$血塗られた眼$$ appeared in $$ラース・バビロン$$, too... I'm sure there's some connection between the $$テンシ$$ and $$サイデリアル$$, but we can't pursue it now...」

277:t_1:86.en:
$n
「I'm sorry I worried you. But... I'm all right.」

277:t_1:88.en:
$n
「I've managed all this time. I'll keep doing the same.」

277:t_1:90.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But after that battle in that space... I think I understand your $$血塗られた眼$$ a little, $n.」

277:t_1:91.en:
$$甲児$$
「So do I. ...You've always been fighting with that feeling.」

277:t_1:93.en:
$n
「But even I managed. I'm sure you guys won't let it crush you.」

277:t_1:94.en:
$$アルト$$
「You talk a good game. No wonder you were the first to stop being the quiet type.」

277:t_1:95.en:
$n
「Shut up, you king of female impersonators.」

277:t_1:96.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「After giving $n such high-handed advice, we have to prove ourselves, too.」

277:t_1:97.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Well, he says we don't need to worry, so I guess we're all right now.」

277:t_1:99.en:
$$ハサン$$
「That's fine, but shouldn't you say something to Miss $$スズネ$$?」

277:t_1:102.en:
$n
「I-I'm sorry, Miss $$スズネ$$! I... didn't know you'd been staying with me...!」

277:t_1:103.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't worry about it. More importantly, take care of yourself.」

277:t_1:105.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「There's that air about her...」

277:t_1:106.en:
$$アルト$$
「Is it happening again, like in the $$時獄戦役$$...?」

277:t_1:107.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Things have certainly been rough ever since the assault on $$ラース・バビロン$$, but...」

277:t_1:108.en:
$n
「...But now we have a way back to Earth.」

277:t_1:109.en:
$$アルト$$
「From Jupiter, we can return to the Earth Sphere with a few folds.」

277:t_1:110.en:
$$甲児$$
「It feels strange to thank being sent to the galactic center, but it also let us learn about the universe's collapse.」

277:t_1:111.en:
$$シン$$
「And we learned about $$サイデリアル$$'s trump card.」

277:t_1:112.en:
$n
「We'll return to Earth and settle our score with the $$新地球皇国$$.」

277:t_1:114.en:
$$甲児$$
「We've got plenty to do. We don't have time to lose to despair or fear.」

277:t_1:116.en:
$n
(Hang on, $$宗介$$... We'll be back on Earth soon.)

277:t_1:117.en:
$n
(I believe... that all of you are safe...)
